scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,safety -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w services/tour-api" "npm run dev:safety"
scripts.build:all: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:api && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w services/tour-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w services/tour-api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w services/tour-api
